Cc: contracts@nimbus.com

Subject: Request: split remit for regional entities + net-terms exception

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the demo last week — Nimbus is excited about the potential. Legal has asked us to propose a small tweak to the Order Form to align invoicing with our entity structure in the EU, and to request a one-off Net Terms exception for the EU entity while we complete vendor onboarding.

Key asks from our side:
- Split billing: EU services invoiced to Nimbus EU (VAT registered) and US services to Nimbus US.
- Net terms: EU entity requests Net 45 for the first two invoices only (temporary, while AP setup completes).
- Evidence: we'll provide VAT registration and local tax certificates if needed.

Can Redwood accept a split remit approach and a temporary net-terms extension? If so, can you loop in legal/finance and share the redline process/timeline? We need to close commercials this month to align with our quarter close.

Attachments: draft_po_example.pdf (for context)

Thanks,
Elena

From: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com

Cc: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-08-05T10:05:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Request: split remit for regional entities + net-terms exception

Elena — thanks, and glad Nimbus liked the demo. Quick read-through below and proposed next steps.

TL;DR: We can accommodate split remit and a short-term Net 45 for the EU entity, subject to: VAT evidence from Nimbus EU, a 20% upfront deposit on the initial invoice, and a short amendment to the Order Form (we'll reference the MSA for payment flow).

Proposed approach:
- Commercial: Redwood issues two invoices where appropriate (Nimbus EU / Nimbus US). EU invoices will be grossed with VAT as required.
- Temporary net-terms: Net 45 for first two EU invoices only; thereafter standard Net 30 per our MSA.
- Upfront: 20% deposit on the first invoice to cover onboarding & capacity reservation.
- PO/DocuSign: we need an executed PO or DocuSign acceptance for the amendment prior to first invoice.

Kimberly and Ben — can you confirm legal/finance acceptance of: (a) a one-time Net 45 exception limited to two invoices, and (b) the deposit plus split invoicing? If acceptable, I'll circulate a focused order-form amendment and request DocuSign. Elena — what's your internal timeline for sending VAT evidence and an executed PO?

Next steps and timeline:
1) This week: Legal/Finance confirm redline guardrails (Ben/Kim).
2) Kar thik to send redline amendment (2 business days).
3) Nimbus returns VAT evidence + signed PO (target: 72 hours).
4) DocuSign routing and invoice scheduling.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15-min call if useful.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
From: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, Elena Soto <elena.soto@nimbus.com>
Date: 2026-08-05T13:22:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Request: split remit for regional entities + net-terms exception

Karthik / Elena — thanks for the context. High-level legal notes (we'll provide a tracked redline):

1) Scope of the exception: any Net 45 concession must be timeboxed and explicitly limited to the first two invoices for Nimbus EU only. We should add language that the concession expires automatically and that any future invoices revert to MSA Net 30.

2) Security for payment: 20% upfront deposit is reasonable. Add a clause that Redwood can pause service if deposits/invoices are overdue beyond a 15-day cure period after invoice issuance.

3) VAT & withholding: we need a copy of Nimbus EU's VAT registration and tax residency certificate before issuing EU invoices. If the EU entity is not VAT-registered, we will invoice gross and Nimbus will be responsible for local VAT/whether reverse-charge applies.

4) Entity names & invoicing party: redline will require explicit invoicing mechanism (billing entity name, tax id, remit address) and an invoicing appendix mapping services to entities.

5) Limitation of liability and currency: keep MSA currency clause (USD default) — if Nimbus requires EUR billing, we add an FX conversion appendix and note exchange-rate risk is to Nimbus.

I attached the initial redline and a short VAT evidence checklist for procurement to complete. Please review and confirm whether the deposit amount and Net-45-for-two-invoices flows are commercially acceptable.

Attachments: redline_order_form.docx; vat_evidence_request.pdf

--
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
From: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com, Elena Soto <elena.soto@nimbus.com>
Date: 2026-08-06T16:02:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Request: split remit for regional entities + net-terms exception

All — agreed on the approach with one commercial tweak. Finance will accept Net 45 for two EU invoices provided:

- 20% upfront deposit is paid and clears before service start.
- The deposit is non-refundable but credited against the first invoice.
- Nimbus agrees to provide VAT registration and a PO or signed DocuSign amendment prior to invoice generation.

Ben's ask: include an invoicing schedule appendix with clear invoice triggers and a fallback clause that routes unpaid amounts to the US entity if EU entity fails to remit after two attempts (this is to protect our receivables).

Karthik — if that matches the commercial concession you were comfortable giving, please share the redline to Elena and include the DocuSign link. If Nimbus can turn the PO + VAT evidence around in 72 hours we can keep the current go-live target.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Head of Finance, Commercials | Redwood Inference
